identity.name: Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (Reality Tokenized)

about.description: rSOXL is a tokenized share of the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares issued by Reality on Arbitrum, designed to track the economic performance of Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares (SOXL) at a 1:1 ratio. The underlying ETF provides 3x daily long semiconductor sector exposure and is designed for short-term trading rather than long-term holding due to compounding effects. Each rSOXL is backed by a corresponding ETF share held through Alpaca Securities LLC, a FINRA-registered and SIPC-covered US broker-dealer, with reserves continuously verified by The Network Firm through Reality's Proof of Asset dashboard. Reality is a regulated RWA issuance platform within the Bitget ecosystem.
